item.title: Maitland · 2026-07-27 · City Council Meeting (City Council): Proposed Millage Rate.
item.description: Five separate motions are required for this agenda Item. (1) Move to set the rolled back millage rate for the 2026 tax year as 4.8685 mills. (2) Move to set the proposed operating millage rate for the 2026 tax year at 5.0465 mills. (3) Move to set the proposed 2004 Voted Debt millage rate for the 2026 tax year at 0.1890 mills. (4) Move to set the proposed 2026 Voted Debt millage rate for the 2026 tax year at 0.2890 mills, for a combined total of 5.5245 mills. (5) Move to set the date, time and place for the public hearing on the tentative budget for the fiscal year 2026-2027 as Monday, September 14, 2026, 6:30 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers.
